heroSummary: Canyons students in grades 1–12 began Monday, August 18, 2025, after a half-day orientation for sixth and ninth grades on August 15. Kindergarten began August 20, and the last day was May 29, 2026. Every instructional Friday was early out, secondary dates followed the printed A/B rotation, and Brighton High School used a separate calendar.
calendarNotes: Canyons scheduled teachers back August 11–15 and a half-day sixth- and ninth-grade orientation August 15 before grades 1–12 began August 18. Kindergarten started two days later on August 20. The K-12 calendar marks every instructional Friday as early out and also identifies districtwide early-out dates September 25, February 12, and February 26. Elementary, middle, and high schools used different conference pairs in September and February, followed by compensatory or professional no-student days. Quarter endings were October 22, January 15, March 20, and May 29, while secondary students followed the red A-day and black B-day sequence printed in the PDF. Brighton High School was excluded from this K-12 calendar and required its own school calendar. The PDF says emergency closures would be recovered through scheduled remote-learning days rather than a preassigned make-up date.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Canyons grades 1–12 start school in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 began Monday, August 18, 2025, after a half-day orientation for sixth- and ninth-grade students August 15.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Canyons kindergarten start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten began Wednesday, August 20, two days after the grades 1–12 opening.

calendarFaqs.q: Was every Friday early out in Canyons School District?
calendarFaqs.a: The revised K-12 PDF says every instructional Friday was early out. Exact dismissal times remained school-specific.

calendarFaqs.q: Did Brighton High School use this K-12 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The official PDF explicitly excludes Brighton students, who needed Brighton's separate school calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Canyons Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break Recess ran Monday, April 6 through Friday, April 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How were emergency closure days made up?
calendarFaqs.a: The PDF says emergency closures would be recovered by scheduling remote-learning days; it does not assign one fixed make-up date.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 10, 2026, against the official School Calendars page and a complete visual rendering of the revised 2025–26 K-12 PDF.
sourceReviewDetails: Confirmed the staggered orientation and openings, all three districtwide early-out dates, level-specific conference pairs, breaks, staff days, quarter endings, and May 29 last day from the official PDF.
The PDF explicitly excludes Brighton High School and says every Friday is early out; both boundaries are visible on this page and in the ICS scope.

The download URL and supplied filename include an April 2 revision label, while the PDF footer itself says Revised 2025.03.27. This page uses the visible PDF footer as the source-version wording and preserves the official URL unchanged.
The emergency-closure note calls for later remote-learning days and does not identify a fixed make-up date.
Daily A/B letters and recurring Friday early outs are not duplicated in the one-time ICS file.
